prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-quality fantasy MMORPG quest marker icon for Ashveil: AVAILABLE OPTIONAL SIDE QUEST. A bold circular medallion / thick open ring in desaturated luminous teal enamel, lightly worn dark bronze edging, with a large simple ivory exclamation mark centered inside. Sophisticated hand-painted game UI sprite, restrained painterly shading, broad clean shapes, strong near-black outer keyline for readability over both bright grass and dark environments. Flat front view, absolutely symmetrical and crisply silhouetted, no perspective. The circle is the categorical silhouette; no diamond, no shield, no crest, no tiny ornament. Clear and recognizable at 32 pixels. Square 1024x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background, one centered isolated icon occupying about 72% of canvas, generous consistent padding, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no glow cloud. No backdrop, no gradient background, no checkerboard drawn into image, no labels, no letters, no watermark. Only the exclamation-mark symbol is present. This is the first of a coordinated set whose other states use a gold diamond for main story and a pale horizontal dash for incomplete/in-progress quests.
